messages:
Mia (SEO): Quick thread to lock the technical SEO checklist for the launch posts + benchmark narrative + webinar landing. Need concrete owners for: canonical rules, redirect mappings, query-param striplist, UTM taxonomy, schema snippets, anchor text map, and staging robots guard. Keep it short.
Nora - Content: I'll freeze hero/inline CTAs and provide the H1/H2 keyword targets per post. Propose primary keywords for the benchmark piece + two supporting longtails. I'll annotate anchor text choices in the draft.
Tobin (Analytics): UTM taxonomy suggestion: utm_source=redwood, utm_medium=content, utm_campaign={launch|webinar|benchmark}_YYMMDD, utm_content=slot_{hero|footer|cta}. Also add a hidden form field page_ref for lead routing. We'll map page_ref -> sales queue.
Priya (PM): Important: staging pages should be blocked from indexing. Add X-Robots-Tag: noindex in staging and meta robots noindex on preview builds. Kevin, can you add that to preview deploys?
Kevin (Dev): Yes. We can add middleware to: set Link rel=canonical -> canonical slug, serve 301s from marketing/seo/redirects.yaml, strip ad params (fbclid,gclid,_gl,utm_test,amp), and set X-Robots-Tag on preview hostnames. I'll include a small smoke test.
Mia (SEO): Redirect mapping: single source of truth in marketing/seo/redirects.yaml. Use explicit mappings where possible; minimal regex. Sam will not be around so Kevin can open the PR. Include a `note` field for why a rule exists.
Nora - Content: For FAQ on the webinar landing, I'll add 3 Qs minimum. Schema: Article for benchmark, Event/WebinarEvent for landing, FAQPage for landing, BreadcrumbList for both. Share snippets in #marketing-drafts.
Tobin (Analytics): We need pixel placement guidance: place both GA4 and optional ad pixel in header for landing only, not on confirmation page (use server-side event there). Also ensure form submission sends canonical slug + utm payload to the webhook.
Priya (PM): Can we get a short example redirect entry so content folks can read it?
Kevin (Dev): Example mapping I'll add to the repo. Snippet: ```
# marketing/seo/redirects.yaml
- from: "/blog/2023/old-benchmark-slug/"
  to: "/benchmark-latency-improvements"
  status: 301
  reason: "removed date prefix, canonical slug"
- from: "/blog/old-slug"
  to: "/blog/new-slug"
  status: 301
  reason: "consolidate duplicate content"
```
Mia (SEO): Canonical policy: prefer short kebab-case slug, no trailing slash for posts, canonical header + HTML rel=canonical for redundancy. For paginated content, link rel=prev/next and canonical to the main series page only if the paginated pages are thin; otherwise canonicalize per page.
Nora - Content: I'll export anchor map: pillar -> benchmark -> webinar. Use descriptive anchors (avoid "click here") and limit identical anchor text to once per page. I'll add `data-seo-anchor` attributes where we want to detect conversions.
Tobin (Analytics): We'll add a lightweight QA: confirm UTMs on CTA links, canonical header present, redirect test (sample legacy -> canonical 301), GA4 event fires on form submit, page_ref flows to CRM. I can run the prelaunch smoke checklist.
deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule prelaunch crawl 48 hours after redirects PR merge.
Priya (PM): Owners: Nora = content + anchors, Kevin = redirects + middleware + preview noindex, Tobin = analytics QA + pixel mapping, Mia = final canonical decisions + schema checklist. Target: everything live 72 hours before webinar.
Mia (SEO): I'll draft a one-page launch SEO QA and post to the playbook. Thanks all  If anything slips, tag me and we'll triage.
